in_sanskrit.name: Bhaben
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the mind
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhaben एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bhaben is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Bhava', which means 'to be' or 'to exist'. The name Bhaben signifies the one who embodies or represents the Lord of the mind. In Hindu mythology, the mind is considered to be the dwelling place of the divine consciousness. Thus, Bhaben is the one who helps one connect with their inner divine self.
